d: Role : Relationship Manager - Wealth Coverage - UAE & International

The role is responsible for driving client acquisition and managing relationships within the Priority and Private Banking segments. The role involves identifying and engaging high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNWIs) both locally and internationally, based on Priority & Private banking qualifying criteria.

The RM will source and cross-sell wealth management and liabilities products, contributing to the growth of the bank's portfolio and overall front-end revenue. This includes utilizing the bank's extensive global network and resources to identify opportunities across various markets where the bank has a presence.
q: Strong understanding of wealth management products, private banking services, and liability solutions.
Ability to source new clients and build long-term, profitable relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage clients in a professional, confident, and approachable manner.
Excellent understanding of the regulatory environment and compliance requirements for wealth management services.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
A high degree of self-motivation, with a focus on achieving set targets. Previous experience:
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in wealth management, priority banking, private banking.
r: Proactively source NTB clients within the Priority and Private Banking segments, ensuring alignment with the bank's qualifying criteria for wealth management services.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing clients, ensuring consistent engagement and satisfaction.
Develop a personalized approach to client acquisition by understanding clients' financial goals, needs, and risk profiles.
Engage with potential clients via targeted outreach, leveraging internal and external networks, local & international branches, events, and marketing initiatives.

Promote and sell a full range of wealth management products, including Sukuk, Structure products, Mutual Funds, BancaTakaful, and other banking solutions, tailored to meet the specific needs of HNWIs and UHNWIs.
Source and cross-sell liability products and mortgages to clients, ensuring appropriate product placement based on individual client circumstances.
Collaborate with product specialists, credit teams, and other internal resources to develop bespoke solutions for clients.

Leverage the bank’s international network to source clients and business opportunities from global markets where the bank has a presence, including the identification of cross-border wealth and liability needs.
Stay up to date with market trends and competitor offerings to ensure the bank’s wealth and liability products remain competitive across all markets.
Lead the client onboarding process, ensuring all necessary documentation, compliance, and KYC are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
Ensure adherence to regulatory guidelines and internal policies related to client account management. Revenue Generation & Targets:
Achieve assigned targets related to client acquisition, wealth revenues and portfolio growth, in line with bank-wide goals.
Monitor, track, and report on performance metrics, identifying areas for growth and improvement.
Ensure the successful cross-selling of a range of products to maximize the lifetime value of each client.
Represent the bank at events, networking opportunities, and private client gatherings to enhance brand presence and generate leads.
Develop a deep understanding of clients' evolving needs and deliver exceptional service to ensure client retention and referrals.
Acquisition of NTB clients for priority and private banking.
Growth in wealth revenues, including assets under management (AUM) and liabilities.
Growth in NTW through targeted wealth management solutions.

d: Zutari designs transport systems that connect people, enable trade, and unlock economic growth across Africa and the Middle East. Our work spans roads, rail, transit, and integrated mobility systems that are safe, efficient, and future-ready.
We are seeking individuals passionate about mobility solutions that go beyond infrastructure and help shape the way cities and regions move.
What kind of talent do we pursue?

We employ high-performing talent with the right attitude and a positive mindset, who are motivated by doing the right thing, getting things done, and share a sense of urgency. People who have an impact on our teams and the broader community. People who think differently and connect with those around them to co-create new opportunities and leave a meaningful legacy. We offer an exciting opportunity for a dynamic and inspiring Senior Roads & Highways Design Engineer
q: Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering with minimum of 10+ years of experience.
Professional engineering accreditation from a recognized institution is preferred.
Proven experience in designing and managing road infrastructure projects, preferably within an engineering consultancy environment.
In depth working knowledge of Middle East Road design standards, regulations, and best practices in the region.
Approved status by local authorities (e.g., RTA, DOT, and DM).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex engineering challenges and propose effective solutions.
Excellent project management abilities, including the capacity to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines and allocate resources effectively.
Strong technical knowledge of highway design principles, standards and software skills (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and MicroStation).
Delivering projects in BIM common data environments, application of Navisworks and similar 3D modelling tools for design and clash detection would be advantageous.
Able to create base design models from agreed work scope with minimal guidance.
Ability to accept delegated responsibility for designated tasks.
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills

We believe that a diverse work force is key to our business success. We seek the best people for our jobs based on their skills, qualifications, and experience. We embrace the principle of equal opportunity in employment, and we work towards eliminating all forms of unlawful discrimination in our employment practices.
r: The role involves leading and devising solutions responding to a wide range of projects including:
Design and development of road infrastructure projects, including feasibility studies, conceptual and detailed designs, and preparation of technical specifications.
Conduct engineering assessments, analyse data, and evaluate road conditions to identify and recommend appropriate design solutions.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate road design with other infrastructure elements, including but not limited to drainage, utility, street lighting and landscaping.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, codes, and standards throughout road project design and construction phases.
Supervise and monitor junior engineers, providing guidance and technical support to facilitate their technical development.
Liaise with clients, authorities, and other stakeholders to effectively communicate project requirements, resolve technical issues, and addressing any concerns.
Monitor project progress, review design changes and manage risks to ensure successful project delivery.
Support in the preparation of technical reports, feasibility studies and cost estimates, contributing to the development of proposals ands.
Ensure, as far as is practically possible, that all assigned work is carried out in compliance with the agreed budget and schedule.
Maintain required technical quality of work.
Keep up to date with technical developments, national and international standards and legislative requirements related to discipline work scope.
Assist Lead Engineer and others when requested in the execution of their responsibilities and duties.
